title: `rebase()` can be blocked by large supply increase
summary: _Resolved_  ## Severity  **Impact:** High  **Likelihood:** Low  ## Description  `Overseer.rebase()` reverts when the calculated APR change since the last rebase exceeds a predefined threshold (`aprThresholdBps`).  ```solidity         int256 aprChange = _calculateApr(timeElapsed, currentSupply, newSupply);          if (aprChange > 0) {             if (aprChange + 1 >= int256(aprThresholdBps)) {                 revert AprTooHigh(aprChange + 1, aprThresholdBps); ```  As `aprThresholdBps` is limited to 10_000 basis points (100%), a large increase in the stHYPE supply might cause the `rebase()` fun
